filesystem.note: /repo is a read-only copy of your source; /data/files is your scratch space

github.note: read the repository, issues and pull requests; code changes go through plan_upgrade, not through this server

slack.note: read channels and history; posting goes through publish(), which holds the mindful gate

wolframalpha.note: computation and facts; the package name is unverified, check with tools_list and replace through the market if it fails

apify.note: run Apify actors: scrapers and crawlers for sources a plain fetch cannot reach

sequential_thinking.note: structured step-by-step reasoning for hard problems
